description:
One company's record and its graph neighbourhood, by id (relays GET /api/v1/companies/{id}). Returns `company` (id, name,
    sector, country, country_code, description, lat, lng, website, confidence), `deposits` it operates (each with `operators[]` and
    their provenance), `infrastructure` it operates, `relationships` (its served edges with tier and provenance — included on paid
    terms), `merged` when the id was merged into another, and `charged_joules`. Only have a NAME? Call `company_search` first to get
    the id. Prefer `relationships` when you only need edges (it walks more than one hop); prefer `entity_state` for a dated packet
    (pins + graph + still). An unknown id is a 404. Metered: charged to your own wallet — see the server instructions (CHARGING); quote first with `billing_quote`.

id.description: The GreenlandAI company id: a whole number (known_companies.id, e.g. "4334"). Get it from `company_search` (by name), a `look_from` / `nearby` pin, a `relationships` row, or a deposit's `operators[]`. A merged-away id answers with the company it was merged into and says so in `merged`.
id.title: Id
